nodes.title: REFERENCE TYPE • OFF depth / ON pose
Show map only when reference is enabled
START • native Turbo studio
widgets_values:
1. Use preset 01 for the tested Ndn quality recipe.
2. Edit the single PROMPT box. Character trigger: r0mdl.
3. Power LoRA Loader: model strengths .75 / .90 / .30 / .35; Single strength per row; CLIP is disconnected and goes directly to the text/detailer nodes.
4. Timer runs in the open ComfyUI tab.
5. Optional tools live below; their switches start OFF.
6. Native/base and final PNGs save separately. KoO Finisher applies grading only to its own export.

Main row: MODELS → PROMPT / SOURCE → SAMPLING → UPSCALE → OUTPUT.
Second row: LOAD IMAGE → FACE / EYES → CRT / JPEG.
Third row: REFERENCE IMAGE → DEPTH or POSE → ROUTING.

nodes.title: MODE GUIDE
widgets_values:
GENERATE: SOURCE off; reference off.
LOAD IMAGE: SOURCE on. Refine input first? off keeps original pixels and size before upscale; on uses the canvas and img2img denoise .25.
REFERENCE: SOURCE off; ENABLE REFERENCE on. TYPE off = depth, on = pose. Model and conditioning switch together automatically.

Presets change modes/settings only; your prompt, input images and character LoRA remain yours. Style presets leave the character row untouched.

Upscale: UltraSharp or NMKD; 4x model then Lanczos .375 = net 1.5x. Both are available in the model selector.
The two Ndn samplers are separate passes, not one continuous 15-step schedule.

nodes.title: OPTIONAL TOOLS
widgets_values:
FACE / EYE DETAILERS: donor Ndn settings restored. Enable only to fix a visible problem; inspect character likeness afterward.
CRT SUITE: original controls retained, built-in upscale OFF to avoid enlarging twice. Turn on the CRT switch to use its grade/grain/lens tools.
MoreJPEG: mild quality 92, blended at .25. The JPEG switch enables it. This changes pixels; SaveImage still saves PNG.

COMPARERS: base versus final above, and before/after optional tools below.
REFERENCE PREVIEW: shows the uploaded image when disabled, the depth/pose map when enabled.

Required: rgthree, RES4LYF, koo-nodes, CRT-Nodes, Impact Pack/Subpack, controlnet_aux, Krea2 ControlNet and Ostris Edit. All node types were found on your instance.
